verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that a Transaction Data Services API returns transaction data for accounts linked via Connect. That data refreshes daily and can be refreshed on demand through Data Refresh endpoints, which delivers the core of pulling transaction history. The pack says nothing about pagination, how far back history goes, or a cursor-style delta pattern; transaction notifications and webhooks are only listed, not shown as a changes-only sync mechanism. missing for 10: documented pagination, documented history depth, incremental/delta sync pattern for fetching only changed transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration
